notes.title: Version 1.5!
notes.notes:
After a month of intense development Smashroom has finally been updated to version 1.5 with new important content. Now the gameplay offers a longer experience full of surprises. An entire new chapter is available with a new boss, new puzzles, scenarios and enemies. Furthermore the game has also been translated in French.

notes.title: Version 1.2!
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 is out!

Features and updates:
- added new languages (Spanish and Romanian)
- new options scheme
- 60, 50 and 30 fps modes
- old-style "scanline" layout
- enemies now have more health and the whole game is a bit harder
- a few more levels have been added

Future update will include:
- new levels
- new mechanics (waterfalls)
- French translations

notes.title: Tips for correct PS4 controllers usage
notes.notes:
Some users might experience difficulties trying to pair their PS4 controller with the gaming application. If the controller is connected via USB cable nothing else is required, just "plug-and-play". In the Options menu, accessible both from the main screen and the Pause screen, it is possible to navigate to the "Inputs configuration" line. PS4 controllers are generally paired on port number 4. It is always possible to change port by using the keyboard arrows, but this is rarely necessary since the game itself automatically recognize the correct port for the controller when this latter is plugged in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37208503/f6696f014ed7b0994d9f343e0f926fa9984660f6.png[/img]

For those users who desire to use the PS4 controller via bluetooth an "interpreter" program is in need (I kindly suggest using DS4Windows, freeware). In this case it is important to set the input port on number 0 instead of 4. The game still recognize a controller through port 4 but it is not capable of interpreting the wireless commands correctly. Some differences might occur between different controllers, but if you want to use bluetooth my suggestion is to always use an auxiliary program like I mentioned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37208503/2e01306be8458c623bd6d412537815afe04e052b.png[/img]

notes.title: SMASHROOM: upcoming indie game
notes.notes:
[h2]Smashroom is going to be released on January 22nd![/h2]

The faith of the forest is threatened by evil forces. A mysterious curse has turned your human body into a small mushroom and your world is invaded by molds, but not all is lost! Your new form comes with new abilities. It's up to you to break this spell and save the forest, maybe you'll even get your humanity back!
